entities.name: Karen Wynn Fonstad
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Karen Lea Wynn Fonstad was an American cartographer and academic who designed several atlases of fictional worlds, including her 1981 The Atlas of Middle-earth, a geographic guide to J. R. Tolkien's high fantasy world.
